**#823 — brain:config first slice: the schema IS the migrations**

PR1 of #814's ruled chain, worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-823, commit 027cdda (unpushed). brain/scripts/config/{config-verb,cli}.mjs + brain:config script. deriveKnownPaths reads the SAME defaults migrateConfig applies: leaves settable exactly, empty-object defaults (sdd.map: {}) are OPEN FAMILIES (sdd.map.<stage> settable). planConfigWrite is PURE (config/migrations/targetVersion received, never read) and runs pending migrations BEFORE the write via installer.mjs's migrateConfig — a second call site, never a re-implementation. Unknown path fails closed naming the nearest family. Atomic write (same-dir tmp+rename). 14 tests RED-first (8 planner on synthetic migrations, 6 CLI on real files/child process). Ships config-migrations-1.4.0.md DRAFT (sdd.engines: {}) — brain/core is Tier 3, human promotes; #824's --record fails closed until then, which is the gate working. Carries the chain's shared SDD trail byte-identical to PR2's (repo:check demands the full trail for the active change at lite — learned when it refused the draft-only dir). Suite 4588/0, repo:check + nav clean.
